title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Paint and Grille Replacement
summary: Hood repainting and grille replacement for a 2017 Toyota Camry XSE at Carcis Autobody Repair.
story: This 2017 Toyota Camry XSE required front-end paint work and component replacement. The scope of work included repainting the hood and replacing the front grille assembly.

To prepare the hood for paint, technicians sanded down the existing finish and filled minor surface imperfections. A multi-stage priming process ensured proper adhesion for the new paint. The hood was sprayed with black basecoat followed by clearcoat to match the factory color and gloss.
The damaged front grille was removed and replaced with a new unit. Technicians aligned the new grille with the headlights and hood edge to maintain proper body lines and factory gaps.
